newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, SOUTH AFRICA BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, SOUTH AFRICA BAT.

text.p: Australia won the toss and put South Africa in to bat in the second of a series of seven one-day internationals on Monday:
South Africa: Adam Bacher, Louis Koen, Jacques Kallis, Daryll Cullinan, Hansie Cronje (captain), Jonty Rhodes, Shaun Pollock, Lance Klusener, Pat Symcox, Dave Richardson, Allan Donald.
Australia: Mark Taylor (captain), Mark Waugh, Stuart Law, Steve Waugh, Greg Blewett, Michael Bevan, Adam Gilchrist, Paul Reiffel, Shane Warne, Adam Dale, Jason Gillespie.
